name: HEAR
description: Evaluating song aesthetics is challenging due to the multidimensional nature of musical perception and the scarcity of labeled data. We propose HEAR, a robust music aesthetic evaluation framework that combines: (1) a multi-source multi-scale representations module to obtain complementary segment- and track-level features, (2) a hierarchical augmentation strategy to mitigate overfitting, and (3) a hybrid training objective that integrates regression and ranking losses for accurate scoring and reliable top-tier song identification. Experiments demonstrate that HEAR consistently outperforms the baseline across all metrics on both tracks of the ICASSP 2026 SongEval benchmark. The code and trained model weights are available at https://github.com/Eps-Acoustic-Revolution-Lab/EAR_HEAR.
reputation: An emerging benchmark for music aesthetics evaluation, currently early-stage and not yet widely adopted outside the associated research line.
notes: Very recent benchmark with limited public history; song aesthetics is subjective and labels may be noisy, so metric values can vary by split and annotation protocol.
